name: Bombino
description: As part of the Dias da Guitarra festival, acclaimed Tuareg guitarist Bombino brings his mesmerizing desert blues to Porto. A powerful and unforgettable live performer.
longDescription:
On May 31, 2026, Casa da Música hosts Bombino, the celebrated Tuareg guitarist and singer-songwriter, as part of the Dias da Guitarra festival. Hailing from Niger, Bombino, whose real name is Goumar Almoctar, is known for his unique blend of traditional Tuareg music with rock and blues influences. His compositions often feature intricate guitar work and rhythmic grooves, reflecting the sounds and stories of the Sahara.

Attendees can expect an evening of compelling live music in the grand setting of Casa da Música. The performance will showcase Bombino's distinctive guitar style and vocal delivery, creating an immersive atmosphere. The venue, a prominent architectural landmark in Porto, offers excellent acoustics for musical performances. The event is likely to attract a diverse audience interested in world music and guitar artistry.

Tickets for the concert start from €20. Casa da Música is located near the Carolina Michaelis metro station (lines A, B, C, E, F), approximately a 5-minute walk. Several bus lines also serve the area. Further accessibility information can be found on the venue's official website.
